The most popular FBC ever sold, in its fourth generation. Raven's pitch hasn't changed since the 2040s: nobody has to know. It passes for meat at a glance, and it's the body most people picture when they imagine going metal and keeping their life.

Cost: 11,200eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 17 (5d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Base chrome (no HL): FBC Gemini Sculpt, Shift Tacts, Techhair
Chrome: Midnight Lady™ or Mr. Studd™, Self-ICE, Skin Weave

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
